title: On-Call Long Range Planning Services
short_description: On-call citywide long-range planning and related consulting services for Bloomington, Indiana.
project_scope: On-call long-range planning services for the City of Bloomington covering citywide needs. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific building, bridge, span, area, or construction scope is defined.
services: On-call consulting services for long-range planning, master planning, land use and redevelopment planning, traffic-related studies/design, civil engineering support, geotechnical engineering, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an on-call long-range planning and urban planning assignment.
- No defined bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural project.
- Includes planning, traffic studies, and urban design rather than structural engineering.
- Matches sbp rejection criteria for pure urban/open space planning and framework-like on-call services without technical structural specification.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction project or budget is stated. The notice is for on-call planning services only, with no defined physical works, size, or technical parameters that would support a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is an on-call planning services procurement without a defined scope, duration-based task volume, or estimated contract value, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Consultant team for on-call services with requested disciplines including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
